book.title: The Working Title of the Book
book.extentSentence: Four large chapters with subsections, approximately 500 pages, at 7 × 10in.

book.what: Contract and deposit. Manuscript intake. Design locked against the AALAI prototype. Interviews begin.
First chapter composed and sent as a proof, so the design is settled on real pages rather than a sample.
Full manuscript composed. Ghostwritten passages start coming back to you for approval.
Complete first proof of all four chapters in your hands. Illustration placement finalized.
Your corrections applied. Humanized passages woven in. Index compiled against real pagination.
Final proof, sign-off, press-ready files to the printer Friday, September 18.
Print, bind, and freight. Print managed on your behalf.

launch.what: Brand positioning. Recorded interviews for both the book and your bio, hooks, and story material.
Media-ready bio, positioning statement, and visual identity delivered. On-camera setup session: backdrop, lighting, wardrobe, framing.
Press release, press kit, excerpts, sample questions and hooks assembled. Pitch pack built.
Testimonial requests go out with the pitch pack. Second session on camera to confirm the setup holds.
Pre-release pitching begins. Podcast outreach through my network. Social series scheduled.
Bookings confirmed and briefed. Testimonials collected and placed. Launch sequence goes live.
You arrive in San Francisco a published author with a booked calendar.
